answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let that stake grow only through verified completed work. A Sybil attacker must then fund every fake identity separately, so forging a thousand willow-thin shells costs as much as a thousand real businesses, while honest agents keep their marble-solid bond intact. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed and its timber-frame reputation collapses, so fakery becomes expensive and honesty stays cheap.
